title: Seasonal subsurface salinity evolution in a Gulf subregion
query: Using the provided GLORYS12 data for 6 August 2016–25 July 2017 in the central Gulf of Mexico (92–88°W, 23–27°N), investigate how subsurface salinity structure evolves seasonally and relates to upper-ocean mixing.
adaptation: Public-data method transfer with reduced scope, authorized 2026-09-08; not exact reproduction of the original observational archive.
